source.title: Alonso the Dragonslayer
source.description:
The time is upon us, <name>. I am adorned with armor befitting a true Dragonslayer! You have been of great assistance.

I should ask that you accompany me now, as my honorary squire, and watch me best the great dragon once and for all!
source.objective: Accompany Alonso to slay the dragon.
source.completion:
I've done it <name>! At last my foe is defeated!

Oh the clash of fang and metal; of scale and blade. What peril, what thrill! And through it all, I arise a champion.

Let us not forget your humble contribution as well! Without the armor you retrieved, I surely would not have bested the fiend.

You have been an excellent squire, <name>. Perhaps, one day, you too shall walk the glorious path of a knight.
